name: Specgen Hash Stamp
description: Auto-generated build stamp containing SHA-256 hash and version string for spec validity checks. Regenerated on every `npm run build` by the build-renderer.js script. Used by SpecsMapPlugin to validate cached spec graph snapshots.

constants.SPECGEN_HASH: string — SHA-256 hex digest of spec files, generated at build time
constants.SPECGEN_VERSION: string — version stamp in format 0.0.<YYYYMMDD>, generated at build time

lifecycle.created_by: build-renderer.js regenerates this file on every `npm run build`
lifecycle.destroyed_by: N/A — module-level constants exist for the lifetime of the renderer process
